title: 十三张单墩获胜动画关键帧
intendedUse: 4×4 序列关键帧图集，裁成 16 帧后输出透明 AVIF 与 Pixi 帧序列，用于单墩获胜提示
prompt: Create an exact 4-column by 4-row transparent sprite sheet of 16 sequential animation frames for a premium Shisanshui card game. Animate one compact ivory-and-warm-gold victory sparkle: frame 1 a tiny dim glint, frames 2-5 a clean expanding gold ring and a few diamond sparks, frames 6-9 a bright but controlled starburst, frames 10-13 sparks drift outward and fade, frames 14-16 return to fully transparent. Keep the effect centered in every equal square cell, same scale and pivot, with no motion crossing cell boundaries. Transparent background. Game-specific visual language: dark emerald game room, restrained gold, crisp soft-edged stylized 3D particles. Effect only; all wording, score and card data are rendered by the game.
negativePrompt: text, letters, numbers, score, labels, panels, cards, suit symbols, characters, background, grid lines, gutters, borders, effects touching neighboring cells, changing camera, inconsistent pivots, harsh bloom, photorealism, watermark, logo

visualReferenceImages.purpose: Use only as the existing particle material and color reference; generate a 16-frame sequence, not a copy of its static layout.
